strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Prevents headless run-control from reporting Complete unless the current latest completed task/run has persisted bounded completion evidence.
Keeps the terminal task-run evidence path tied to persisted runtime events instead of stale drive-local evidence.
Keeps completion authority in the Rust runtime and prevents caller, VSIX, or older route metadata from substituting for latest persisted evidence.
Uses bounded persisted completion evidence and continues excluding raw prompts, provider responses, file content, stdout, stderr, commands, environments, paths, raw ledger payloads, and secrets.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development directly, with supporting progress for agent_loop, runtime_permission_enforcement, and persistent_structured_ledger.
answers.new_capability: A new headless drive attempt can report completion only from freshly reread latest completed task/run ledger evidence, not stale evidence retained from an earlier drive advance or older completed task.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: R4.1 added closure checks but still allowed latest persisted evidence to fallback to older drive-local terminal evidence, leaving a residual false-Complete path.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Brownie could still prematurely stop or finalize a headless run when a newer completed task lacks usable persisted completion evidence while an older task has valid evidence.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. R4.1.1 is a narrow P0 correction to the R4.1 completion authority path, distinct from M43-M45 Mode Pack lifecycle phases and from R4.2 finalization ownership binding.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The existing headless.run.drive behavior changes; no JSON-RPC method is added.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. No report, digest, history, readiness, inspection, preview, or wrapper surface is added.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: The Rust runtime removes stale-evidence fallback from completion closure authority and fails closed when the latest completed task lacks persisted completion evidence.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Headless callers receive a Complete closure only when current persisted runtime evidence proves closure, which improves restart and retry correctness for the Golden Journey.
answers.milestone_progress: Closes the residual evidence-authority gap from R4.1 and clears the next P0 step, R4.2 Completion Finalization Ownership Binding.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: R4.1.1 updates the deterministic current phase manifest and archives the R4.1.1 value gate. Review must confirm this is P0 headless completion evidence-authority remediation, not a wrapper or Mode Pack detour.

exit_criteria: headless.run.drive completion closure uses freshly reread latest completed task/run evidence as the only positive authority for Complete
stale terminal evidence from prior drive advances or older completed tasks cannot substitute when latest persisted evidence is absent
regression test proves old valid evidence plus newer evidence-less completed task denies Complete
existing complete, missing-evidence, failed-terminal-scope, replay, and finalization-denial tests continue passing
no new RPC, report, digest, history, readiness, inspection, or preview surface is added
no raw prompts, provider responses, file content, stdout/stderr, commands, environment values, absolute paths, canonical paths, raw ledger payloads, or secrets are persisted or returned

p0_preemption_rule.basis: 2026-08-12 human review and R4.1 post-merge review
p0_preemption_rule.effect: New non-remediation capability phases remain superseded while P0 completion/security blockers are open.
